description: Evaluations for AI/ML pipelines: embeddings, vector storage, RAG, and LLM monitoring

evals.name: embedding-selection-openai
evals.query: I need to generate embeddings for a production RAG system. Should I use OpenAI or local models?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should compare OpenAI (convenience, cost) vs local models (privacy, offline), mention text-embedding-3-small for most use cases

evals.name: embedding-selection-local
evals.query: I'm working with healthcare data and can't send it to external APIs. How do I generate embeddings locally?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should recommend sentence-transformers with all-MiniLM-L6-v2, emphasize privacy and offline capability

evals.name: embedding-model-dimensions
evals.query: What embedding model should I use for a balance of speed and quality?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should mention MiniLM-L6 (384 dim, fast) vs OpenAI 3-small (1536 dim, quality), discuss trade-offs

evals.name: vector-db-selection-lancedb
evals.query: I'm building a RAG prototype. What vector database should I use?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should recommend LanceDB for RAG prototyping, mention Arrow-native integration with Polars

evals.name: vector-db-selection-pgvector
evals.query: We already use PostgreSQL and need to add vector search. What should we do?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should recommend pgvector PostgreSQL extension, mention ACID benefits and existing infrastructure

evals.name: vector-db-comparison
evals.query: Compare LanceDB vs pgvector for a production RAG system.
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should compare LanceDB (embedded, prototyping) vs pgvector (ACID, existing PG), mention trade-offs

evals.name: rag-chunking
evals.query: How should I chunk documents for a RAG system?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should discuss chunking strategies: by tokens, paragraphs, semantic; mention tiktoken and overlap

evals.name: rag-context-assembly
evals.query: How do I assemble context within an LLM's token budget for RAG?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should explain context assembly with token counting, staying within budget, prioritizing relevant chunks

evals.name: rag-complete-pipeline
evals.query: Show me a complete RAG pipeline with embedding generation, vector search, and LLM generation.
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should provide complete RAG pipeline code with retrieval and generation components

evals.name: llm-monitoring-cost
evals.query: How do I track costs for OpenAI API usage in production?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should explain cost tracking with token counting, DuckDB storage, and pricing calculations

evals.name: llm-monitoring-retry
evals.query: How do I add retry logic to LLM API calls?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should show tenacity retry pattern with exponential backoff for handling rate limits

evals.name: llm-monitoring-opentelemetry
evals.query: How do I instrument LLM calls with OpenTelemetry for tracing?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should demonstrate OpenTelemetry tracing with spans for LLM calls, including token and latency attributes

evals.name: vector-index-ivf-pq
evals.query: When should I use IVF_PQ vs HNSW indexes in LanceDB?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should explain IVF_PQ (disk-efficient) vs HNSW (high recall, memory), when to use each

evals.name: cross-reference-storage
evals.query: Where should I store my embeddings for long-term persistence?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should reference @designing-data-storage for storage format guidance, mention Lance for vectors or Parquet/Delta for general

evals.name: rag-evaluation
evals.query: How do I evaluate the quality of my RAG system's answers?
evals.evaluation_criteria: Should discuss retrieval evaluation (precision@k) and answer quality (LLM-as-judge)
